description: This file defines a utility class StringUtils providing static methods for string manipulation, especially converting camelCase to underscore case, exploding camelCase strings, and translation of class names.

classes.name: StringUtils
classes.description: A utility class with static methods for string manipulation including case conversions and camel case handling.

methods.name: camelToUnderscoreCase
methods.description: Converts a camelCase string to snake_case or UPPER_SNAKE_CASE based on the $uppercase flag.

methods.name: camelToTranslation
methods.description: Attempts to translate a camel-cased string into a human-readable label, falling back to a space-separated capitalized string if translation not found.

methods.name: explodeCamelCase
methods.description: Splits a camelCase string into its constituent parts as an array.
